title: Locked migration runner for CI metadata
name: Schema migration runner

questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this code applies and records schema migrations? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
Two deploy pods start the runner at the same moment against the same database. What happens?
choices: Both apply pending migrations concurrently, and the second fails on a duplicate key
The second blocks on pg_advisory_lock, then finds the migrations already recorded and runs nothing
The second fails immediately because the lock is taken
Each pod applies a disjoint half of the pending migrations

questions.prompt: Migration 01's up() is edited after it was applied in production, and the runner starts. What happens?
choices: It reapplies 01 with the new code
It skips 01 silently and applies the rest
It throws before applying any later pending migration
It applies later migrations, then reports the mismatch

questions.prompt: The process is killed halfway through the backfill (migration 03). What is the state on the next run?
choices: 03 is not recorded, so it runs again and only updates rows still NULL
03 is recorded, so the remaining NULL rows are never filled
All backfilled rows are rolled back and 03 starts from scratch
The runner refuses to start until 03 is manually cleaned up
